description: AlterVision helps retail teams analyze visitor traffic, sales, conversion rates, and progress toward store and seller targets. Connect an existing account to find stores, compare daily performance, review sales competition standings, and investigate why visits did not become purchases through reason summaries and seller-recorded explanations. Non-conversion reports and sales competitions require AlterVez access.
